integrity.method: Nine-cell linear-extension recurrence over all 729 successor-map choices and independent enumeration of all 362880 rank matrices.
integrity.reproducibility: Included standard-library verify.py checks the complete rank census and all stated probabilities.
integrity.scientific_status: Finite exhaustive proof, with no external or independent validation claimed.

scientific_limitations: Exact theorem applies to independent identically distributed atomless entries of a 3-by-3 zero-sum payoff matrix.
Entry time counts edges in the six-vertex alternating-best-response digraph, not iterations of arbitrary play protocols.
No extension to higher strategy counts and no general convergence-to-equilibrium claim are proved.
Potential unindexed equivalent exact finite enumerations remain a literature-access risk.
title: An exact transient-depth law for \(3\times3\) random zero-sum best-response dynamics
